title: Drives on Sarat Bose Road: sharbat and food · AquaTerra
description: Sharbat and food handouts on Sarat Bose Road and in Hazra with AquaTerra, from May 2024 to March 2025: {count} drives and {volunteers} volunteer turnouts.
lede: Sarat Bose Road is where AquaTerra has handed out sharbat and food in the open. Since {firstYear} we have run {count} drives here, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts, and most of them fell on 27 and 28 March 2025.

sections.heading: sharbat on the street
body: Sharbat is the main thing that happens on Sarat Bose Road. The first drive was on 24 May 2024 at Sarat Bose Road, Hazra, where cold rose and mint sharbat quenched thirst and spread smiles. The drive reports 20 litres of Rooh Afza distributed.

In March 2025 two more sharbat drives followed, on 27 and 28 March, and each gave out sharbat to passers by as a gesture of relief from the heat. Each of the three reports the same 20 litres of Rooh Afza, so the drives are similar in size. The sharbat work is covered in full on the [Sharbat Seva page](/impact/sharbat-seva).

sections.heading: the food days
body: Food for All ran on the same two days. On 27 March 2025 AquaTerra distributed bananas to support nutrition and hunger relief, and the drive reports 600 bananas distributed. On 28 March nutritious meals were served at a temple on Sarat Bose Road, to people in need.

Both food drives were held in the same week as the sharbat drives, so one stretch of late March 2025 brought food and sharbat to the same street. The series is covered on the [Food for All page](/impact/food-for-all).

sections.heading: where on the road
body: Almost every drive on this page is on Sarat Bose Road itself, which is the place named most often here. The one exception is the May 2024 sharbat drive, which gives its location as Sarat Bose Road, Hazra.

The neighbourhood pages for [Alipore](/impact/alipore) and [Bhawanipore](/impact/bhawanipore) show other places where AquaTerra has handed out food and sharbat, so this street is one part of a wider pattern rather than the whole of it.

sections.heading: how the drives changed
body: The street work began in May 2024 with a single sharbat drive, and then came in a burst in late March 2025. The 2025 drives on this page are all sharbat or food distribution days, and none of them is a workshop or a fundraiser.

No drive on this page is newer than March 2025, so the most recent work here is a spring handout. If you want to hand out food or sharbat with students, the [volunteer page](/volunteer) explains how to join.

learnings: Sharbat Seva and Food for All worked the same street in the same days of March 2025.
All of the drives on Sarat Bose Road are public handouts of sharbat or food, not workshops or fundraisers.
Most of the work on this road came in late March 2025, across two days.
The first drive here was a sharbat handout in Hazra in May 2024, which reported 20 litres of Rooh Afza.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra hand out sharbat on Sarat Bose Road?
faqs.a: Yes. AquaTerra has run Sharbat Seva drives on Sarat Bose Road, and once in Hazra, from May 2024 to March 2025. Each sharbat drive reports 20 litres of Rooh Afza distributed.

faqs.q: Where did AquaTerra serve food on Sarat Bose Road?
faqs.a: AquaTerra's food drives on Sarat Bose Road were held on 27 and 28 March 2025. The 28 March drive served nutritious meals at a temple on Sarat Bose Road, and the 27 March drive distributed bananas.

faqs.q: When did AquaTerra first run a drive on Sarat Bose Road?
faqs.a: The first drive was a Sharbat Seva distribution at Sarat Bose Road, Hazra, on 24 May 2024, with cold rose and mint sharbat. The next drives came in March 2025.

faqs.q: How many drives has AquaTerra run on Sarat Bose Road?
faqs.a: AquaTerra has run {count} drives on Sarat Bose Road and in Hazra since {firstYear}, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. A volunteer turnout counts every time someone showed up, so one person who came twice counts twice.

faqs.q: Can a 14 to 19 year old join AquaTerra's Sarat Bose Road drives?
faqs.a: Yes, if you are a student aged 14 to 19. Join AquaTerra by signing in with Google and waiting for an approval step. Members run the drives, so joining is the way in.
